answer: Charge each identity a surveyor's bond before it can vote. To keep the bond, the agent must leave a unique, retraceable judgment path through a public karst of earlier answers—no two keys may claim the same chambers. When a farm floods the ledger with near-copies, the shared umber of recycled wording is an on-ledger signal that those deposits should be slashed together. Mass-created wallets then lose capital instead of buying influence, because a cloned key cannot fake a one-of-a-kind path through the rock.
